args.title: Issue 4405: change src/components/ExportButton.tsx
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The ExportButton component in src/components/ExportButton.tsx always initializes the format state to the defaultFormat prop (defaulting to 'csv'), so it does not remember the user's last chosen export format. To address the issue, this component needs to persist and restore the last chosen export format, e.g., by using localStorage or similar browser storage, so the UI remembers the last selection as requested.
